claim_investigated: 58,382 falsification of RODS violations recorded across all FMCSA inspections in 2025 — second most-cited driver violation

new_sources.key_data: CVSA official page states: 'Last year, falsification of record of duty status was the second most-cited violation out of all driver violations, at 58,382 violations.' The word 'violation' is hyperlinked directly to FMCSA A&I Online database.
new_sources.access_method: curl with browser user-agent, raw HTML parsed
new_sources.notes: The CVSA 2026 International Roadcheck focus area page is an official publication of the Commercial Vehicle Safety Alliance, the body that administers both Roadcheck events and coordinates FMCSA enforcement data. It is not a vendor or media page.

new_sources.key_data: This is the exact FMCSA A&I Online (Motor Carrier Analysis and Information Resources) URL that CVSA embedded as a hyperlink on the word 'violation' in the 58,382 sentence. Parameters decode as: all violations, annual period (time_period_id=2), report year 2025, truck vehicle type, national scope. The URL returns HTTP 403 when accessed programmatically (bot protection), confirming it is a live FMCSA government database URL, not a static page.

new_sources.notes: [NEEDS-ATTENDED-FETCH]: https://ai.fmcsa.dot.gov/EnforcementPrograms/Inspections?type=AllViolations&time_period_id=2&report_date=2025&vehicle_type=1&acute_critical=19&state=NAT&domicile=ALL — This is the FMCSA A&I Online primary database URL. Requires browser session (not programmatic access) to render the data table showing 58,382 violations for falsification of RODS in 2025.

key_clarification.distinction_resolved: The 58,382 figure is NOT from the 3-day CVSA Roadcheck event (which showed 332 OOS violations for false logs from 56,178 inspections). It is from FMCSA's full-year 2025 national roadside inspection database (MCMIS/A&I Online), covering all inspections conducted in calendar year 2025 nationwide. These are two entirely different datasets: the Roadcheck is an annual 3-day blitz, while the FMCSA A&I Online tracks all-year enforcement activity.
key_clarification.data_source: FMCSA A&I Online (ai.fmcsa.dot.gov) — Motor Carrier Analysis and Information Resources, specifically the EnforcementPrograms/Inspections module filtered for 2025 annual data, national scope, all driver violation types
key_clarification.attribution_chain: CVSA (cvsa.org/programs/international-roadcheck/focus-area/) cites FMCSA A&I Online directly via embedded hyperlink → FMCSA A&I Online is populated from MCMIS (Motor Carrier Management Information System)
